titulo: A1 review and mock test: Speaking and writing tasks with a self-check list

aula.objetivo: Review all of A1 in one map, practice reading, listening, speaking and writing with a self-check list, correct the most common mistakes of English speakers and take an original scored mock test covering lessons 1 to 17.

sessao.titulo: Speaking and writing tasks with a self-check list

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: before each task read the list below. STEP 2: do the task, preferably recording yourself or writing it out. STEP 3: listen to or read your own work and tick each row. STEP 4: if you cannot tick a row, go back to the lesson on the right and repeat that part. There is no score here; the goal is that you know exactly which points still need work.

tabela.ask_yourself: Did I nasalize «não, bom, mãe» without a clear «n»? Did I say the final «l» as «oo»? Did I say «tchi / dji» before «i»?
Did I use «ser» for who or what and «estar» for where and how?
Do articles, adjectives and colors agree in gender and number?
Do my -ar, -er and -ir verbs have the right ending for the person?
Did I say «meu / minha» correctly and «no, na, do, da» when needed?
Did I say times with «às» and prices with «reais»?
Did I use «querer, poder, precisar de, ter que» + infinitive without extra words?
Did I put the reflexive pronoun before the verb («me levanto»)?
Did I use «gostar de» with «de», and «adorar / detestar» without it?
Did I use «ir + infinitive» for plans and «estar + gerund» for now?

erros.errado: Reading the text without recording it
erros.motivo: You hear your own mistakes much better when you listen than when you speak.
Fluency practice needs flow. Correct on the second pass.

erros.errado: Writing in English and translating word by word
erros.certo: Start with the sentence patterns you know
erros.motivo: Use «Eu gosto de…», «Eu vou…», «Eu tenho que…»; they are safer than translation.

blocos.enunciado: Speaking task 1, introduce yourself (about one minute): say your name, where you are from, your age, where you live, who is in your family, what you do and what you like. Record it and tick the self-check list.
blocos.exemplo: Meu nome é Anna. Sou de Londres e moro em São Paulo. Tenho vinte e oito anos. Minha família é pequena: meus pais e minha irmã. Eu trabalho numa escola. Gosto de cozinhar e adoro música.

blocos.enunciado: Speaking task 2, three situations (about one and a half minutes in total): (a) at a café, order two things and ask for the bill; (b) in the street, ask where the bathroom or a bank is and understand the answer; (c) in a shop, ask the price of a shirt and say whether you will take it. Record and tick the list.

Writing task: write an e-mail of about 70 words to a Brazilian friend. Say what time you get up and what you do on a normal day, what you like and do not like, and what you are going to do next weekend. End with a question. Then read it aloud and tick the self-check list.
blocos.exemplo: Oi, Rafael! Tudo bem? Eu me levanto às sete e tomo café da manhã. Trabalho de manhã e estudo português à tarde. Gosto de música, mas não gosto de acordar cedo. No fim de semana vou ao cinema com minha irmã. E você, o que vai fazer? Um abraço, Anna

blocos.enunciado: Warm up out loud: say your name, your age, where you live and one thing you like. Then count from 1 to 20 and from 20 to 100 in tens.
